mapper.select: SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", s.stock_code AS "code", a.quantity AS "shares", a.purchase_amount AS "buyPrice", a.avg_price AS "avgBuyPrice" FROM asset a JOIN stock s ON a.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", tl.trade_quantity AS "shares", COALESCE( (SELECT a.avg_price FROM asset a WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND a.stock_code = so.stock_code), (SELECT tl_buy.trade_price FROM trade_log tl_buy JOIN stock_order so_buy ON tl_buy.order_id = so_buy.order_id WHERE so_buy.account_id = #{accountId} AND so_buy.stock_code = so.stock_code AND so_buy.transaction_type = 'BUY' ORDER BY tl_buy.trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) ) AS "buyPrice", tl.trade_price AS "sellPrice", (tl.trade_price - (SELECT buyPrice)) * tl.trade_quantity AS "profit", CASE WHEN (SELECT buyPrice) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((tl.trade_price - (SELECT buyPrice)) / (SELECT buyPrice)) * 100, 2) END AS "profitRate", DATE_FORMAT(tl.trade_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "tradeDate" FROM trade_log tl JOIN stock_order so ON tl.order_id = so.order_id JOIN stock s ON so.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE so.account_id = #{accountId} AND so.transaction_type = 'SELL'
AND tl.trade_date >= #{startDate}
AND tl.trade_date <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
ORDER BY tl.trade_date DESC

SELECT s.stock_name AS "stockName", s.stock_code AS "stockCode", o.quantity AS "orderQty", o.order_price AS "orderPrice", o.transaction_type AS "type", (o.quantity * o.order_price) AS "orderAmount", DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "orderTime", /* 개별 체결 수량 */ COALESCE(tl.trade_quantity, 0) AS "executedQty", /* 누적 체결 수량 (윈도우 함수 사용) */ (o.quantity - COALESCE( SUM(tl.trade_quantity) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.order_id ORDER BY tl.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ), 0) ) AS "unexecutedQty", ((o.quantity - COALESCE( SUM(tl.trade_quantity) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.order_id ORDER BY tl.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ), 0) ) * o.order_price) AS "unexecutedAmount", tl.trade_price AS "executedPrice", DATE_FORMAT(o.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "executedTime" FROM stock_order o JOIN stock s ON o.stock_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN trade_log tl ON o.order_id = tl.order_id WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.created_at >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY tl.trade_date DESC

SELECT m.nickname AS "nickname", a.account_number AS "accountNumber", a.balance AS "balance", a.account_created_at AS "createdAt" FROM account a JOIN member m ON a.user_id = m.user_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
